تستغنون (form X)
# تَسْتَغْنُونَ (tastaḡnūna) /tas.taɣ.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
# تُسْتَغْنَوْنَ (tustaḡnawna) /tus.taɣ.naw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْنَى (istaḡnā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
